method.order: AB/BA alternating, three warmup pairs excluded
method.cache: OS cache warm, not flushed; DB restored from identical A seed per append sample
method.refresh: refreshSummary return including session commits; DB open, source preparation/restoration and validation excluded
method.parseAndStage: synchronous reader processBatch: A line/JSON/adapter/TEMP, B line/JSON/adapter/memory DTO; includes name metadata; nested within reader and total refresh
method.map: B Map merge uses original in-memory normalized DTOs only; selectedLoadMs includes Map selection+one deferred SQL load; profile counts SQL event/usage inserts separately
method.profile: one separate untimed diagnostic run per variant; JSON.parse and row adapter clocks plus memory sampled after each batch; JSON.parse also includes cached DTO restore
method.memory: process high water includes earlier scenarios, module load and validation; batch samples can miss transient peaks; heap/RSS are not per-stage allocation
method.queries: all result pages; each sample three warmups and ten calls, original filter and completed-request denominator
method.append: 1 Claude; 1,100,1000 Codex requests added to same largest accepted file, counts before addition; entire changed file reparsed
method.snapshot: local-only fixed copy retained in ignored tests/.cache for reproducibility; report excludes source paths/content
